weapon.d: If unit initiates combat, inflicts Atk/Spd/Def/Res-4 on foe during combat.
If unit initiates combat, inflicts Atk/Spd/Def/Res-4 on foe during combat.

If unit's HP ≥ 25% at start of combat, grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+5 to unit and unit makes a guaranteed follow-up attack during combat, and also, if unit is within 2 spaces of an ally and unit's Res > foe's Res, reduces damage from foe's attacks by difference between stats during combat (max 20; excluding area-of-effect Specials).
If unit's HP ≥ 25% at start of combat, restores 7 HP to unit after combat.

special.d: Boosts damage by 50% of unit's Res.
Boosts damage by 50% of unit's Res.

a.d: If unit initiates combat, grants Res+2 during combat.
If unit initiates combat, grants Atk/Res+2 during combat.
If unit initiates combat, grants Atk/Res+4 during combat.

c.d: At start of turn, inflicts Res-3 on foes in cardinal directions with Res < unit's Res through their next actions.
At start of turn, inflicts Res-4 on foes in cardinal directions with Res < unit's Res through their next actions.
At start of turn, inflicts Res-5 on foes in cardinal directions with Res < unit's Res through their next actions.
